The app downloads the public price file from tarifnisemafor.si only when needed: a few days or weeks before the valid price list expires and occasionally during the year. It sends only the request for the file, without data about you or your phone. The hosting provider automatically records the IP address and time of the request; this record is deleted within about one day and the developer does not use it. Your price choice stays on the phone.
The price is for information. The exact amount is on the bill of the supplier and of the distribution system operator.
